title: Module 5 Quiz: Automated Trading & Risk Analysis

questions.text: What is the primary purpose of a protective stop-loss rule in algorithmic trading?
options: To guarantee profit on every trade
To limit loss by triggering a sell at a pre-set level
questions.explanation: A stop-loss order caps losses by automatically selling when the price reaches a preset level.

questions.text: What does Value-at-Risk (VaR) measure in AI-supported risk analysis?
options: The maximum possible loss in a year
The average return of the portfolio
The loss threshold that could be exceeded with a small probability under normal market conditions
questions.explanation: VaR estimates the loss level unlikely to be exceeded given normal market conditions and a confidence level.

questions.text: True or false: A flash crash can be worsened when many automated systems react to similar signals and sell simultaneously.
questions.explanation: Concurrent selling by algorithms can accelerate price drops during a flash crash.

questions.text: True or false: AI-supported risk analysis guarantees that a portfolio will never lose more than the Value-at-Risk amount.
questions.explanation: VaR is a statistical estimate, not a guarantee against larger losses.
